title: rest(/meta read gate): enforce a list view's and a dashboard's `requiredPermissions` on the list read and the by-name read, so each audience is served only its own views and boards (the rest half of #22611)
body:
This card carries the **rest-gate half** of #22611 (ruling `6095014058`, letter A). #22611 keeps the **spec half**: the `requiredPermissions` key on `ListViewSchema` and `DashboardSchema`. The objectui half (the dashboard direct-URL refusal shown to the user) is filed when this half is accepted.

Blocked-by: #22611

Filing gate: **② the seat files a follow-up the ruling named.** The director's ruling on #22611, verbatim: "the spec seat files the rest-gate half (`domain:cli`: the list and by-name reads of `view` and `dashboard` in the `/meta` read gate, pinned per audience)". Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · session `session_01KNKBCRDJCu5tGy3TEbvtrF`. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades and routes it on first touch.

## What the ruling asks of this half

From `6095014058`, verbatim: "The `/meta` read gate applies it on the list read and the by-name read of both types, so `GET /api/v1/meta/view` returns only the views the caller may see, and a dashboard's direct URL is refused by the server; the console's view switcher already reads the server's list (`ds.listViews` → `GET /meta/view`), so it follows."

The key has the same shape and semantics as on apps, navigation items, actions (ADR-0066 D4) and record blocks (#18159): a list of capabilities, **all** required. ⛔ No any-of form (B was not taken). "Or" is a capability granted to several permission sets.

## Where it lands (read at `origin/main` `1b99388505`; the claimant re-measures)

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`:
  - the app arm's `requiredPermissions` check (`filterAppForUserWithReason`, about `:713`, `every` at about `:741` and `:758`) is the precedent for the evaluation;
  - the `dashboard` arms (about `:1395` and `:1533`) gate widgets by `requiresService` today, with no audience check;
  - the `view` reads (the packaged base at about `:2128`, the `object`-scoped list at about `:2549`).
- **To measure:** how the existing `authorExempt` rule (an author who may save an item reads the stored item whole) applies to a view or dashboard the author cannot see; whether the list read and the by-name read share one predicate; and what a refused by-name read answers (status and code), consistent with the app arm's whole refusal.

## Done when

- `GET /api/v1/meta/view` (list and by-name) and the dashboard reads serve a gated item only to a caller holding all of its `requiredPermissions`; pinned per audience (holder served, non-holder not served, no key served to all).
- #22611's liveness rows for both keys flip from `planned` to `live`, citing this gate.

## Why this half is urgent once #22611 lands

Until this lands, the spec declares a key that no server reads. #22611's liveness rows say so (`planned`, carrier this card). A release cut between the two landings would publish an audience key that hides nothing.
